_comment: Per-number trim settings (seconds). Applied when splitting video parts.

_help.start_trim_sec: Extra seconds to skip after the number card ends (or after marker start if start_trim_from is marker_start).
_help.end_trim_sec: Cut this many seconds BEFORE the next number marker at the END of a part. Part 5 ignores end_trim_sec.
_help.start_trim_from: marker_end (recommended) waits until the card disappears. marker_start trims from detection time.
_help.min_score_margin: Optional. How much this number must beat the runner-up during matching. #4 uses 0.05 by default.
